title: Integrate accepted TopFace model into original runtime and optimize real FPS
acceptance: Same frozen model and thresholds integrated into original TOP interface with rejection and calibration guards; preserved QR/LANE and active/draft; source-bound native deployment and full recognition/preview FPS measured; exact private backup

reconciliation_note.reason: Old SD is connected with firmware v1.8-36, /sdcard free blocks=0 and /data statvfs total/free=0. Add a preflight guard so the existing /data output route fails before camera start when the data volume is unavailable.
